message:
## Vulnerability Digest

This primary product scan used only `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt`; obvious aliases and duplicate product/version entries were consolidated. The scan window was **2026-10-07 23:40 UTC through 2026-10-08 23:40 UTC** (**2026-10-08 05:10 IST through 2026-10-09 05:10 IST**).

One newly resolved MongoDB ecosystem security issue and one materially updated critical Cisco advisory were verified as relevant. No other credible, in-window vulnerability report could be confidently matched to the monitored products.

### Finding 1 — PyMongo BSON decoder out-of-bounds read (PYTHON-6110)

- **Affected product/component:** PyMongo BSON C-extension decoder
- **Issue:** PYTHON-6110; proposed for a CVE, but no CVE was assigned in the available source
- **Severity:** Not formally stated
- **Description:** A malformed BSON Regex element in an application-supplied non-sentinel buffer such as `mmap` can make `bson.decode` or `bson.decode_all` read beyond the buffer and terminate the process with `SIGSEGV`. The issue is availability-only according to MongoDB's assessment and is not reachable through the driver's current wire path.
- **Why relevant:** MongoDB is in the monitored inventory, and PyMongo is an officially maintained MongoDB driver covered by the mandatory ecosystem sweep. MongoDB resolved the security-tagged issue on October 8 and released PyMongo 4.18.3 with the fix.
- **Source:** [MongoDB PYTHON-6110](https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/PYTHON-6110) and [PyMongo 4.18.3 release](https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/t/pymongo-4-18-3-released/344145)

### Finding 2 — Cisco NX-OS NX-API remote code execution (CVE-2026-76471), advisory updated

- **Affected product/component:** Cisco NX-OS on supported Nexus platforms and Cisco UCS fabric interconnects when NX-API is enabled
- **Severity:** Critical, CVSS 9.8 (Cisco)
- **Description:** Insufficient validation in NX-API can allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to send a crafted HTTP request, execute code as root, or cause a denial of service.
- **Why relevant:** Cisco Nexus and Cisco UCS are both in the monitored inventory. Cisco updated the advisory's fixed-release table at **2026-10-08 14:11 UTC**, inside this scan window. The vulnerability itself was initially disclosed at 2026-10-07 16:00 UTC, outside the window, so this entry is an in-window remediation update rather than a newly disclosed flaw.
- **Source:** [Cisco security advisory](https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/content/CiscoSecurityAdvisory/cisco-sa-napi-rce-r2shwu2j) and [NVD CVE-2026-76471](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-76471)

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, and major officially maintained libraries and services. Apart from PYTHON-6110 above, no credible MongoDB-family vulnerability was newly reported or materially updated in the scan window.

### Review priority

Immediate review is recommended for deployments with NX-API enabled because Cisco rates CVE-2026-76471 critical and changed the fixed-release guidance during this window. Teams that use PyMongo to decode untrusted BSON from `mmap` or another non-sentinel buffer should also review the 4.18.3 fix.
